author.parent_disclosure: No case text, setup facts, case-specific gold or interpretation has been sent to the parent before the candidate freeze.

execution_precondition: Use existing Primary-only qualification owner/gate, no worker. Any dynamically delegated Goal naturally stays queued; no pause action is added. Only twelve planned turns; the sixteen-call gate supplies no retries, resampling or extra cases.
limitations: Synthetic author cases, not human-authored or human usefulness evidence.
Not independent of all prior design/prompt/corpus knowledge; independence applies to authoring and withholding before the new fix implementation and candidate freeze.
Setup validation proves fixture compatibility only, not semantic model behavior or host security/recovery correctness.
No actual model/provider performance, Qwen qualification, UI, Expert or artifact proof.
No retrospective rescore or replacement of earlier failures; no claim of general accuracy beyond the finite observations if later executed.
parent_read_policy: Do not open primary-clarification-heldout.json until the next candidate product/prompt source freeze is recorded. Register the exact frozen corpus hash through the existing cohort path only after that boundary; no new harness is required.
serialization: UTF-8, ensure_ascii=false, sort_keys=true, indent=2, trailing LF; SHA256 covers exact file bytes.

timing_and_independence.prior_familiarity: Author knows the existing D029 design, existing product prompt and harness, earlier heldout/review cases, original fixed regression corpus and reported R02/R10 unnecessary-question failures from prior work.
